nodes.label: W3C RDF 1.1 Concepts and Abstract Syntax Recommendation
nodes.description: Core W3C specification defining the abstract data model for Resource Description Framework (RDF) graphs, including IRIs, literals, blank nodes, and dataset semantics.

nodes.label: RDMA over Converged Ethernet Version 2 (RoCEv2) Network Protocol
nodes.description: Network protocol allowing Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) over Ethernet fabrics using UDP encapsulation, enabling low-latency, zero-copy interconnects for distributed graph processing.

nodes.label: Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT) Cryptographic State Tree Architecture
nodes.description: Authenticated radix trie data structure combining Patricia tries and Merkle trees to provide deterministic state verification and light-client cryptographic proofs for high-throughput graph mutation logs.

nodes.label: CRYSTALS-Kyber-768 Lattice-Based Post-Quantum Key Encapsulation Algorithm
nodes.description: Module Lattice-Based Public Key Encapsulation Mechanism providing Security Category 3 (equivalent to AES-192) quantum resistance for secure CXL memory fabric sessions.

nodes.label: AlKhalil Morphological Analyzer v2 for Standard Arabic
nodes.description: System for morpho-syntactic analysis of Standard Arabic words based on root-and-pattern modeling, providing precise part-of-speech tagging, lemmas, and root identification.
